source_summary: Ink landscape with layered mountains, pine-covered slopes, river/mist spaces, small waterside buildings, a boat, and dense foreground trees and rocks. Calligraphy, red seals, borders, and paper wear are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: distant_left_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the soft, dark distant mountain silhouette in the upper left background, including its rounded peak, descending shoulders, pale mist at the base, and diluted ink wash texture.
must_preserve: uneven ink density along the left slope

motifs.name: central_craggy_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the large central-left rocky mountain ridge with layered ridgelines, pale slopes, darker ink creases, dotted shrubs, and small adjoining foothills at its base.
must_preserve: angular peak and arcing ridge profile
parallel contour strokes on the slopes
dotted shrub rows following ridge edges
soft wash transitions into the lower foothills

motifs.name: middle_valley_mist_and_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the misty middle valley behind the central ridge: low receding hills, pale mountain silhouettes, and open atmospheric wash between the left and right ranges.

motifs.name: right_pine_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the right midground hillside and mountain shoulder with terraced slopes, clustered dark shrub dots, tall vertical pines, and the pale peak behind them.
must_preserve: pale rear peak with soft wash
dry-brush rock striations on the lower slope

motifs.name: riverside_pavilion_pine_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small rectangular waterside pavilion or boat-house near the center, together with the immediate bank and the dense vertical pine cluster directly behind it.
must_preserve: pitched roof geometry with ink outlines
dark supports reflected at the waterline
vertical pine trunks behind the roof
low rocky bank under and beside the structure

motifs.name: midriver_small_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small covered boat on the mid-right water, including its low hull, arched woven canopy, tiny stern and bow strokes, nearby small rock, and sparse water ripples.
must_preserve: open surrounding water margin needed to read the boat

motifs.name: foreground_willow_and_leafless_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground grove on the central island: drooping willow, gnarled leafless branching tree, darker leafy clusters, bamboo-like foliage, trunks, rocks, and shrub-dotted ground immediately around them.
must_preserve: drooping willow fronds with fine parallel leaf strokes
gnarled pale trunks with dark outline accents
fine twig network of the leafless tree
rocky mound contours and dotted ground shrubs
overlapping ink washes around the tree bases

motifs.name: lower_right_pavilion_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the small lower-right thatched pavilion tucked below the foreground trees, with its roof, posts, adjacent rock ledge, shoreline, and calm water strokes.
must_preserve: sloping thatched roof with fine parallel strokes
pale platform or bank line beneath the pavilion
angular rock ledge to the right
horizontal shoreline and water ripple marks
nearby overhanging branch tips without unrelated calligraphy or seals

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
